fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: Rejecting the judgment is rejecting Allah’s sovereignty
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“Ibn Taymiyyah explained that returning to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ in dispute is an obligation, and that abandoning this contradicts Īmān.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The duty to return to the revelation is not theoretical. It is the measure of faith, obedience, and loyalty to the Dīn.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā, Abschnitte über Verpflichtung, nach Allah und Seinem Gesandten ﷺ zu richten.
